ops-oncall: Heads-up — we're seeing a flurry of gRPC stream resets through edge in eu-west-1 starting ~09:10 UTC. Began when autoscaler started the GPU ramp.

maria: seeing that too. ingestion and streaming backends with long-lived chats impacted. lots of 504s in the logs

ajay: logs?

ops-oncall: paste logs below

ops-oncall: ```
2026-03-18T09:11:02Z upstream reset: HTTP2 RST_STREAM (0x1) stream_id=45
2026-03-18T09:11:02Z connection close: ECONNRESET src=10.0.5.18:443 dst=10.10.0.7:53412
2026-03-18T09:11:03Z grpc: Received RESET_STREAM, code=14
``` 

kevin: @maria any config changes to haproxy/nginx at the same time? We rolled out the gpu pool config 09:08 UTC

maria: no edge proxy changes. Deploy-bot started rollout for gpu-scale-eu-west1 at 09:07

deploy-bot: Started rollout: gpu-scale-eu-west1 (group 3/5) :rocket:

lina: could be ephemeral port exhaustion on the NAT egress path — scaling added many new nodes, all egressing through same NAT gateway

ajay: can we check conntrack counts on the NAT? also SYN_RECV patterns

ops-oncall: running quick check against fw-nat-1:

ops-oncall: ```
# conntrack -S | grep entries
conntrack entries: 198271
conntrack max: 262144
# ss -s | grep TCP
TCP: inuse 198270 orphan 0 tw 1234 alloc 1500 mem 1234
``` 

kevin: 198k connections — that's high but under max. tw=1234 is suspicious. Are we reusing ephemeral ports? check ephemeral range

maria: ephemeral range is default 32768-60999. New pods are creating many short-lived outbound streams (streaming proxies opening many outbound conns per client)

lina: NAT port churn + long-lived HTTP/2 multiplexing mismatch could lead to stream resets if the gateway is recycling mappings mid-stream

ajay: also saw increased kernel logs on nodes: "ip_conntrack: table full" earlier by some nodes

ops-oncall: I can add a temporary second NAT gateway in eu-west-1 and route a subset of nodes to it. Want to test if resets drop.

kevin: please do. Also enable keepalive pings for the proxy -> edge hop to reduce idle timeouts

maria: created route update for pool-a -> nat-2. Will apply in 2 mins.

deploy-bot: Route update applied for pool-a -> nat-2

ops-oncall: quick smoke after move: stream resets down from ~120/s to ~6/s. 504s drop significantly.

lina: nice. postmortem action items: increase conntrack max on NATs, add autoscaling for NATs during GPU pool scaleups, and reduce outbound ephemeral port reuse by introducing eBPF-based socket reuse policy

ajay: add monitoring alert when conntrack entries > 70% and TW sockets > 1000

maria: also log and correlate deploys -> NAT load to avoid surprises during scaleouts

ops-oncall: will open incident ticket and assign follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident #INC-2026-103 opened: "Edge gRPC stream resets during GPU scaleup - eu-west-1" assigned to ops-oncall
